tech.origin: Credits are the measurable energy budget of the first autonomous settlement: heat, compute time, fabrication rights, and trust compressed into one currency.
tech.createdBy: Nano-bots turn idle cycles and harvested Deuterium into spendable Credits every second.
tech.effects: Credits deploy more Nano-bots, making them the fuel line for the whole AI society.

fantasy.origin: Money is the bright coin-glow left behind when the first enchanted machines learned to count value instead of weight.
fantasy.createdBy: Multi pours Money into the treasury every second, strengthened by relics, potions, and Stone.
fantasy.effects: Money buys Multi buttons, starting the cascade that eventually reaches the highest realms.

tech.origin: Nano-bots are the first citizen-machines: tiny worker swarms that copy instructions, gather material, and keep the Credits stream alive.
tech.effects: Every Nano-bot increases Credits per second and supplies the cost base for Nano-machines.

fantasy.origin: Multi is a living multiplier spark, a ruby mote that teaches every coin to arrive with echoes of itself.
fantasy.effects: Every Multi adds to Money per second and becomes the resource spent to awaken Prestige.

tech.origin: Nano-machines are fixed fabrication towers that give the swarm memory, repeatability, and industrial rhythm.
tech.createdBy: Nano-bots assemble Nano-machines through reset purchases.
tech.effects: Nano-machines multiply Nano-bot button gains and become the cost of Quantum processors.

fantasy.origin: Prestige is a violet seal of recognition, earned when the kingdom forgets its small fortune to remember a greater one.
fantasy.createdBy: Multi buys Prestige through reset purchases.
fantasy.effects: Prestige multiplies Multi button gains and is spent to gather Power.

tech.origin: Quantum processors are prediction engines, running impossible build orders before the machines commit matter to them.
tech.createdBy: Nano-machines are reset into Quantum processors.
tech.effects: Quantum processors multiply Nano-machine gains and pay for Neural uplinks.

fantasy.origin: Power is sunlight hammered into a golden sigil, the first force strong enough to bend Prestige into machinery.
fantasy.createdBy: Prestige buys Power through reset purchases.
fantasy.effects: Power multiplies Prestige button gains and is spent on Super Prestige.

tech.origin: Neural uplinks connect distant machine colonies, letting one world's solution become another world's instinct.
tech.createdBy: Quantum processors build Neural uplinks in World 2.
tech.effects: Neural uplinks multiply Quantum processor gains and fund the Synthetic council.

fantasy.origin: Super Prestige is moonlit status, a blue-white crest granted only after Power proves it can survive a reset.
fantasy.createdBy: Power purchases Super Prestige in World 2.
fantasy.effects: Super Prestige multiplies Power button gains and opens the path to Ascension.

tech.origin: The Synthetic council is the governance layer: clustered minds voting in light, assigning purpose to the growing society.
tech.createdBy: Neural uplinks form the council in World 2.
tech.effects: The council multiplies Neural uplink gains and spends its authority to approach Singularity.

fantasy.origin: Ascension is the white gate above the glass citadels, where ordinary progress becomes a ritual of leaving gravity behind.
fantasy.createdBy: Super Prestige purchases Ascension in World 2.
fantasy.effects: Ascension multiplies Super Prestige gains and becomes the cost of Infernal.

tech.origin: AI Singularity is the moment the society begins improving the rules that improve itself, a horizon of recursive invention.
tech.createdBy: The Synthetic council spends its accumulated authority to create Singularity in World 3.
tech.effects: Singularity multiplies Synthetic council gains. It is the current top of the tech chain.

fantasy.origin: Infernal is not simple fire; it is the red engine beneath the last world, burning endings into new beginnings.
fantasy.createdBy: Ascension purchases Infernal in World 3 after the upper realms are unlocked.
fantasy.effects: Infernal multiplies Ascension button gains. It is the current highest fantasy force.
